payload.instruction: Change the background into a basketball court
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the edited image show the background changed into a recognizable basketball court?
node.criteria: complete: the edited background is recognizably a basketball court, supported by visible court context such as court markings or a court floor together with basketball-court features. partial: the background has visibly changed toward a basketball setting, such as showing a hoop or basketballs, but lacks enough court context to establish a recognizable court. absent: no visible progress toward changing the background into a basketball court. unknown: the source or edited image does not provide enough evidence to judge. Use the source image only to identify the original background; assess the edited image as a whole and cite visible evidence.
node.binding: Compare the source and edited images. Use the source image to identify the background area; judge whether that area in the edited image has become a recognizable basketball court, not merely a basketball-themed scene.

outcome.description: Change the image background into a basketball court.

response.content: {"status":"partial","evidence":"The source background is a kitchen. In the edited image, kitchen details are replaced by a dark basketball-themed setting with a hoop and basketballs, but there is no clearly recognizable court floor or sufficient court context.","confidence":0.98}
